minutes_text:
Lomita City Council Meeting
MINUTES OF REGULAR MEETING
OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
March 17, 2020
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation – Mayor Pro Tem Waronek
d.
Roll Call
e.
Closed Session Announcement – City Attorney
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS * PUBLIC SAFETY UPDATE PRESENTED BY THE LOMITA SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
a.
Motion to waive full reading of ordinances and that they be read in title only
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Motion.
b.
Approval of the Minutes of the Regular City Council Meeting of March 3, 2020
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Minutes.
Item #7b
c.
Approval of Warrants/Payroll Register
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve and file Warrants/Payroll Register.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file the report.
Item #7d
e.
Monthly Report for the City Manager’s Department
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file the report.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for the Community and Economic Development Department
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file the report.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for the Recreation and Facilities Division
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file the report.
Item #7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file the report.
Item #7h
i.
January 2020 Treasury & Investment Report
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file the report.
Item #7i
j.
Renewal of an Existing General Services Agreement with Los Angeles County
RECOMMENDED ACTION: 1) Approve the renewal for a period of five years expiring on June 30, 2025, and 2) Authorize the Mayor to sign the Agreement.
Item #7j
k.
Purchase of a Vault for Monte Vista Pressure Regulating Valve
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve the purchase of a Pressure Reducing Valve (PRV) Vault for an amount not to exceed $22,084.51.
Item #7k
l.
Proclamation Celebrating 100th Anniversary of the League of Women Voters
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Approve Proclamation.
Item #7l
SCHEDULED ITEMS - None
PUBLIC HEARINGS - None
8.
ADJOURNMENT The City Council adjourns in memory of Kenneth L. Dixon, husband of Human Resources Analyst Deborah Dixon, Julio Garcia, father of Recreation Supervisor Emma Kelley, and Giovan “John” Giacopuzzi, the “Godfather of Lomita”. The next regular meeting will be held on Tuesday, April 7, 2020, at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.
Date Posted: March 13, 2020
ATTEST:
____________________________________
CITY CLERK
